title: Measuring the Prepayment Still Held on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation
content:
What counts as the prepayment still held on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on how many prepayment lines the folio carries against the rooms standing, and on what the rate plan booked takes at booking.

## The rule

1. Where the prepayment lines posted on the reservation outnumber the rooms standing on it and the rate plan booked takes the whole stay at booking, the prepayment still held is the booked nightly rate multiplied by the nights the reservation covers and by the rooms standing on it.
2. Where the prepayment lines posted outnumber the rooms standing and the rate plan booked takes a deposit expressed in room nights, the prepayment still held is the booked nightly rate multiplied by the deposit nights the rate plan carries and by the rooms standing on the reservation.
3. In every other case the prepayment still held is every prepayment line posted on the reservation.

Prepayment lines outnumber the rooms standing when the count of those lines on the folio is greater than the number of rooms the reservation holds; where the count equals or falls short of that number, the third case governs.

## What each plan takes at booking, and its deposit nights

| Rate plan | Whole stay taken at booking | Deposit nights carried |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | yes | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | yes | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 1 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no | 1 |
| Member Flex Rate | no | 1 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no | 2 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0 |

The first case reaches the three plans that take the whole stay at booking; the second reaches the four that take a deposit in room nights instead.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A reservation covering 5 nights with 2 rooms standing, carrying 3 prepayment lines and a booked nightly rate of 180.00 USD. Three prepayment lines outnumber 2 rooms, so the first or the second case governs according to the plan booked.

- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, which takes the whole stay at booking, the prepayment still held is 180.00 USD multiplied by 5 nights and by 2 rooms, which is 1,800.00 USD.
- On the Suite Flexible Rate, which takes 2 deposit nights, the prepayment still held is 180.00 USD multiplied by 2 deposit nights and by 2 rooms, which is 720.00 USD.
- On the Semi-Flexible Rate, which takes 1 deposit night, it is 180.00 USD multiplied by 1 and by 2 rooms, which is 360.00 USD.

Had the same reservation carried 2 prepayment lines against its 2 rooms, the lines would not outnumber the rooms, and the prepayment still held would be every prepayment line posted on it.
